name: chatterbox-turbo
licenseNote: COMMERCIAL-OK. MIT — usable in commercial and closed-source products per resemble.ai. Clears Safebux-metered serving AND IPFS/EBS redistribution with no separate license step. This is the Fish-S2 replacement that is actually serveable.

weights.note: Real SHA-256 captured from HF at rev 3c40542. Other files (s3gen.safetensors ~1.06GB, conds.pt, merges.txt, added_tokens.json) — capture their hashes from the repo at the pinned revision at build.

resources.recommendedGpu: 1x consumer GPU (8-12GB). 350M params — light, single-GPU. ~6x realtime, ~75ms latency on a modern GPU.

watermark: Every output carries Resemble's PerTh (Perceptual Threshold) neural watermark — imperceptible, survives MP3/edits, ~100% detection. Note this for tenants: generated audio is watermarked by the model itself.
notes: Chatterbox-Turbo (350M), MIT-licensed, zero-shot voice cloning + emotion control + native paralinguistic tags. The commercial-safe expressive TTS to pair with Kokoro (Kokoro = cheap Apache baseline, no cloning/emotion; Chatterbox = MIT expressive + cloning). Resemble's own blind test claims it beat ElevenLabs in ~63.75% of preferences — VENDOR-RUN, treat as 'same class', A/B on your own audio before betting on it. An ONNX build exists (ResembleAI/chatterbox-turbo-ONNX) for the light onnx runner. Multi-language: see chatterbox-multilingual (23+ langs, also MIT).
